categories.main_business_segments: Keep Inc. operates primarily in three business segments: self-branded fitness products, online membership and paid content, and advertising and others. The company offers a comprehensive fitness solution including AI-assisted personalized fitness content, smart fitness devices, fitness gear, apparel, and food, integrating physical and digital fitness experiences.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages AI-powered and data-driven technologies, including generative AI and a proprietary AI vertical model called Kinetic.ai, to deliver personalized workout plans and fitness insights. It develops smart wearable fitness devices in-house, including wristbands and smartwatches, and integrates extensive fitness data from over 22 million smart devices to enhance user experience and product innovation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Keep serves individual fitness enthusiasts across various sports categories, ranging from beginners to advanced users. Its customers include end-users purchasing fitness content and products, advertisers utilizing its online platform, and wholesale channels distributing its self-branded fitness products. The company primarily operates in the fitness and wellness industry in China.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company is headquartered in Beijing, China, with a principal place of business in Hong Kong. Its operations and user base are primarily concentrated in China, with some expansion into overseas markets through AI-enabled fitness applications and content offerings.
categories.supply_chain_position: Keep operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the fitness ecosystem. It develops and sells self-branded fitness products (including smart devices and apparel), provides online fitness content and membership services, and offers advertising platforms, thus controlling both product development and direct consumer engagement.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on enhancing its AI-powered and data-driven fitness ecosystem, expanding its online fitness content, and innovating wearable fitness devices. Key R&D initiatives include generative AI content creation, development of AI coaching agents, and integration of multidimensional fitness data to personalize user experiences and improve monetization.
categories.revenue_model: Keep generates revenue through sales of self-branded fitness products via online retail and wholesale channels, subscription fees from online membership and paid content, and advertising sales on its platform. It also derives income from online sports events and other ancillary services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, Keep positions itself as a market leader in China’s online fitness ecosystem, leveraging its first-mover advantage in AI-powered fitness technology and a comprehensive product portfolio. It competes by integrating content, devices, and data analytics to offer differentiated and personalized fitness experiences.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Keep reported revenues of approximately RMB2.07 billion, a slight decrease of 3.4% year-over-year, with a gross profit margin of 46.7%. The company experienced an adjusted net loss of RMB469.6 million due to increased investments in strategic and technological initiatives. It maintains a large user base with nearly 30 million average monthly active users and 3.2 million subscribing members, aiming for breakeven in 2025.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Keep emphasizes its unique value proposition through an AI-powered, data-driven fitness ecosystem that offers personalized workout plans, extensive fitness content, and smart wearable devices. Its integration of multidimensional fitness data and generative AI enables tailored coaching and enhanced user engagement, differentiating it from traditional fitness platforms and products.
